$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Unique service id, e.g. "kettleback-carrying-fee". Stable once shipped.

notes.description: Who sells it, why this price, for owner review.

providerNpcId.description: The NPC creature who provides the service.

name.description: What a listing shows, e.g. "Carrying fee".

price.description: Fixed crowns. Give exactly one of `price` and `priceFormula`.

priceFormula.description: A price that eases with the provider’s disposition toward the player.

perDisposition.description: Crowns knocked off per point of disposition above 0 (rounded down).

conditions.description: Conditions (logic DSL) that must all hold to buy; none = always.

items.description: A logic DSL node: an object with a `kind` and that kind’s fields.

showWhenLocked.description: Unmet conditions: `true` lists the service locked, `false` hides it.

effects.description: Effects (logic DSL) applied with the payment, all or nothing. None = a pure fee. `purchaseService` is not allowed here.

items.description: A logic DSL node: an object with a `kind` and that kind’s fields.
